meta.title: 面试时四看，判断未来领导靠不靠谱
meta.title_en: Four Things to Look For When Judging a Future Boss

scenes.title_en: A Good Boss Is a Mentor
scenes.context: 讲者指出工作没劲、看不到成长可能是因为跟错了领导，好领导是导师。
sentences: 工作越干越没劲，越干越看不到自己的成长，因为你跟错了领导。
If work gets more draining and you see no growth, you've probably picked the wrong boss.
跟错了领导：picked the wrong boss
好领导就是一位好导师，会身体力行地去教你去引导你。
A good boss is a mentor who teaches and guides you by example.
身体力行：by example
好的领导既会磨砺你，恰当的时候也会提拔你。
A good leader challenges you, but promotes you when the time is right.
磨砺你：challenge you
paraphrase: 成长停滞 → 先检查领导
When growth stalls, check the leadership first.
好领导 = 磨砺 + 提拔
A good boss both sharpens and elevates you.
scenes.speak: If work gets more draining and you see no growth, you've probably picked the wrong boss. A good boss is a mentor who teaches and guides you by example. A good leader challenges you, but promotes you when the time is right.

scenes.context: 讲者给出前两个评估维度：尊重看面试体验，专业看观点深度。
sentences: 好的领导在面试中会给到你一个相对良好的面试体验。
A good boss gives you a decent interview experience.
面试体验：interview experience
你要评估一下面试官的观点或解答是不是具备专业性。
You should assess whether the interviewer's views and answers are truly professional.
具备专业性：truly professional
如果面试官的专业水平还不如你，未来你的成长会非常有限。
If the interviewer is less professional than you, your future growth will be very limited.
成长有限：growth will be limited
paraphrase: 尊重 = 态度的温度计
Respect is the thermometer of attitude.
专业 = 能力的水位线
Expertise sets the ceiling for how much you'll learn.
scenes.speak: A good boss gives you a decent interview experience. You should assess whether the interviewer's views and answers are truly professional. If the interviewer is less professional than you, your future growth will be very limited.

scenes.context: 讲者给出后两个维度：开放看是否接纳建议，激情看讲业务时是否眼睛放光。
sentences: 好的领导面对合理建议，是很愿意去接纳的。
A good leader is willing to take on reasonable suggestions.
接纳建议：take on suggestions
如果面试官一味地否定甚至打击你，被PUA的概率非常高。
If the interviewer keeps rejecting or belittling you, you're very likely to be gaslighted later.
PUA：gaslight
好的领导讲到自己的业务和团队时，眼睛是放光的。
When a good leader talks about their business and team, their eyes light up.
眼睛放光：eyes light up
paraphrase: 开放 → 决定相处模式
Openness decides how you two will work together.
激情 → 决定团队氛围
Passion reveals the energy of the team.
scenes.speak: A good leader is willing to take on reasonable suggestions. If the interviewer keeps rejecting or belittling you, you're very likely to be gaslighted later. When a good leader talks about their business and team, their eyes light up.

practice: 表达「评估面试官专业度」
I asked about the technical details to gauge the interviewer's expertise.
He was very open to my suggestions.
His eyes lit up when talking about the team—that's a leader worth following.
An interview goes both ways—I'm evaluating them too.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：He points me out of problems.
✓ 地道说法：He challenges me and helps me grow.
磨砺不是指出问题，用 challenge / push 表达。
✕ 直译腔：His eyes are letting out light.
✓ 地道说法：His eyes light up.
眼睛放光是 eyes light up，不要直译。
✕ 直译腔：He always hits you in the interview.
✓ 地道说法：He keeps rejecting or belittling you.
打击用 belittle / put down 表达。
✕ 直译腔：The experience of interview is good.
✓ 地道说法：He gave me a decent interview experience.
shifts: 面试只想着被考察、表现好
面试同时考察领导：尊重、专业、开放、激情
只看薪资和岗位选工作
把「跟对领导」也纳入决策权重
把面试官的热情当成全部
四维综合判断，热情只是其中一项
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「带人接物」按语境校正为「待人接物」，个别停顿处标点按口播节奏整理。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
